finalText:
**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All parse clean under `node --check`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Two `db.query` calls still live there.

`cache.query` is a different object. I did not touch it.

Next: decide on the vendor file. Wrap it or wait for an upstream release.
